correctness.rationale: The repaired theorem preserves the verified dynamics and makes the asymptotics apply directly to every positive orbit. A resident fixes T_i=c_i, while absence forces T_i=r and noninvasibility requires r≤c_i; this gives the monotone scalar equilibrium equation and unique selected equilibrium, not uniqueness of all boundary equilibria. With x_i=γN_i, the local uptake and consumer entropy derivatives cancel to −α_i x_i^*(T_i−t_i) for residents, and to (α_i r−k_i)x_i for missing consumers. Substitution of the local and global equilibrium balances gives the stated weighted AM–GM dissipation (the factors in each pair/triple multiply to one). Entropy bounds all coordinates above and positive-reference coordinates away from zero. At zero dissipation R=r and all T_i=t_i; the constant local resource equations then force x_i=x_i^* even for the neutral consumer. This justifies LaSalle on a compact sublevel set; the log-growth limit follows by time averaging. At β=β_j the quadratic dissipation on the remaining resource/resident variables dominates the shared squared deviation and all squared normalized resource differences; its invariant nullspace is zero by the local equations. The larger missing consumers add strictly negative eigenvalues by block triangularity. Thus the face Jacobian B is Hurwitz. If y=x_j>0 and z is the other deviation, smooth factoring and y'/y→0 give (z/y)'=(B+o(1))(z/y)+b+o(1), with limiting response −B^(-1)b by a quadratic stability estimate. This establishes the slaving limit without requiring the orbit to start on a center manifold or asserting exponential decay of the raw remaining coordinates. With δy=1, resident δT_i=0, larger absent δT_i=δR, and δT_j=δR−α_jr/β, the shared balance gives δR=−α_jr/[1+β(j−1)]. Then (1/y)'→−α_jδT_j>0, yielding all three amplitudes with the original N_j=y/γ normalization. Fraction arithmetic independently reproduced the two example abundance/shared-nutrient pairs (7/81,−2/9) and (3/7,−3/7). The uploaded checker was inspected, not executed; finite integration is not the proof.

value.rationale: The verified extension bridges a gap left by stationary survivor thresholds and positive-equilibrium stability: it identifies the limiting boundary even at neutral invasion. The three paired amplitudes explain how a marginal abundance tail coexists with negative first-order resource shifts and quantify the effect of resident count on the shared shift, beyond a generic statement of critical slowing. The result is scoped to the deterministic abstract model and not framed as a new staircase or a biological intervention.
